facts.claim: On 31 December 2026 the City of Sydney's programme runs a smoking ceremony at 7.30pm, the Calling Country fireworks at 9pm, curated by We Are Warriors, and the midnight fireworks, launched from the Harbour Bridge, the Opera House and other landmarks.

sources.title: City of Sydney: Sydney New Year's Eve schedule

facts.note: The City updates the event pages through November and December; recheck before 31 December.

facts.claim: The City of Sydney says Sydney New Year's Eve attracts more than one million people to Sydney Harbour and surrounding areas.

sources.title: City of Sydney: visiting Sydney for New Year's Eve

facts.claim: The City lists 48 vantage points for 2026; Lower Bradfield Park's paid tickets go on sale at 9am on 7 October, the Opera House Forecourt's free tickets at 10am on 26 December, and Clark, Goat and Shark islands, Bradleys Head and Strickland Estate were sold out by 5 October.

sources.title: City of Sydney: ticketed vantage points

articles/where-to-stay-in-sydney-new-yea: Clark Island, Goat Island and Shark Island

facts.claim: Darling Harbour is a free New Year's Eve vantage point with its own fireworks at 9pm and midnight over Cockle Bay; alcohol is prohibited there.

articles/where-to-stay-in-sydney-new-yea: its own fireworks at 9pm and midnight

facts.claim: For New Year's Eve 2026 most free vantage points are alcohol-free zones, most don't allow re-entry, and Circular Quay Station closes from 3pm to midnight; the City suggests Wynyard, Martin Place or St James, and Victoria Cross for North Sydney.

sources.title: City of Sydney: fireworks viewing guide

facts.claim: On New Year's Eve no unauthorised vessels may enter the harbour exclusion zones from 8pm to 12:45am on New Year's Day.

sources.title: City of Sydney: boating on New Year's Eve

facts.claim: On New Year's Eve 2026 access to Cockatoo Island / Wareamah is limited to guests booked to stay there; houses and apartments went to a ballot from 3 September and campground bookings opened on 22 September 2026.

sources.title: City of Sydney: ticketed vantage points

articles/where-to-stay-in-sydney-new-yea: only to guests booked to stay there

facts.claim: Sydney Airport is around 20 minutes from the city centre by train, according to the City of Sydney.

sources.title: City of Sydney: visiting Sydney for New Year's Eve

facts.claim: YHA Sydney Harbour requires a minimum 7-night stay for all New Year's Eve 2026 bookings, and from 4pm on 31 December 2026 to 7am on 1 January 2027 its rooftop is limited to guests on its NYE package, who must be 18 or over.

sources.title: YHA: New Year's Eve 2026 at YHA Sydney Harbour

articles/where-to-stay-in-sydney-new-yea: from 4pm on 31 December to 7am on 1 January

facts.claim: On 5 October 2026 Shangri-La Sydney's New Year's Eve offer was listed from USD 1,738 a night on average, and its terms say a minimum length of stay applies.

sources.title: Shangri-La Sydney: New Year's Eve 2026 offer

facts.note: The site converts prices by visitor currency; we quote the USD figure shown when we checked.

facts.claim: Shangri-La Sydney has 565 rooms and suites over 36 levels at 176 Cumberland Street, The Rocks, with a restaurant and bar on level 36.
Four Seasons Hotel Sydney rises 34 storeys with 531 rooms and suites at 199 George Street; its full-harbour rooms look at the Harbour Bridge and the Opera House.

sources.title: Four Seasons Hotel Sydney: deluxe full harbour room

facts.note: fourseasons.com refuses automated fetches; confirmed through search results from the hotel's own pages.

facts.claim: Sofitel Sydney Darling Harbour has 590 rooms and suites at 12 Darling Drive, a minute's walk from Darling Harbour, sold as harbour, city or bay view.

articles/where-to-stay-in-sydney-new-yea: 590 rooms and suites at 12 Darling Drive

facts.claim: Hyatt Regency Sydney, at 161 Sussex Street, opened under the Hyatt Regency brand on 1 December 2016 with 892 rooms.

sources.title: Hyatt Newsroom: Hyatt Regency brand returns to Sydney

facts.claim: The Great Southern Hotel Sydney has noisy works from 10am to 4pm between 31 August 2026 and 31 January 2027, and no on-site parking from 28 September 2026 until about 31 January 2027.
facts.note: The hotel extended the works from 30 November 2026; corrected publicly on 5 October 2026.
